steps.what: Ensure the equipment is in good working order

tasks.design: The photographer tests equipment prior to use to ensure that it is in good working order. The test stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} passes the equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer tests the equipment before the job.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored tick passes the equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Judging working order stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not take out equipment that failed the test.
tasks.altitude: The test stays at full effort.

reach.task: Bring the equipment to be tested

evidence.claim: Testing photographic equipment before use stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with equipment and ends when the photographer has tested it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A repair, if one is needed, is a different task.
unknowns: Which items are tested before every job.
research_questions: How often did the photographer leave an item behind because it failed?

already_counted.description: Testing the equipment is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the test adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every item is still tested by the photographer. High: the same test remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure light and apply exposure formulas

steps.what: Measure light levels and distances using measuring devices
Apply stored formulas to numbers of exposures needed
Estimate whether the exposure numbers should be kept

tasks.design: The photographer estimates or measures light levels, distances, and numbers of exposures needed, using measuring devices and formulas. The measurement and the estimate stay at full effort. {SPREADSHEET} only multiplies stored readings by a stored formula. A blank reading stays blank and is not treated as zero. No model is called. The formula does not set the camera.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer measured the light and worked the formula by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored formula can multiply stored readings. The measurement and the estimate stay manual.
tasks.still_hard: Measuring the light and deciding the exposure stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer rejects a number that treats a blank reading as zero.
tasks.altitude: The arithmetic is a formula. The measurement and the estimate stay at full effort.

evidence.claim: A stored formula can multiply stored light readings. Measuring the light and estimating the exposure stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a scene and ends when the photographer has estimated the exposures, or stops.
A reading has scene identifier, light level, and distance, entered by the photographer from the device. A blank level is left blank and is not treated as zero.
The formula does not set the camera and does not shorten the measurement.
unknowns: Which formula this studio uses for a count of exposures.
research_questions: How often was a reading blank, so the photographer measured again?

already_counted.description: Measuring light levels is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a reading the photographer has remeasured.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: readings are often blank, so the measurement is unchanged. High: readings are complete, the formula runs, and the photographer still estimates the exposure. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule, keep books, and order supplies

steps.what: Do scheduling of appointments for general office duties
Total stored amounts for keeping books
Review the book totals before an order
Perform the general duty of ordering supplies

tasks.design: The photographer performs general office duties, such as scheduling appointments, keeping books, and ordering supplies. Scheduling stays a conversation at full effort. {SPREADSHEET} only totals stored amounts. A blank amount stays blank and is not treated as zero. The photographer reviews the totals and still places the order, at full effort. The order is not sent by a rule. An existing diary is not counted as saved labour.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer scheduled the appointment, kept the book, and placed the order.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored amounts can be totalled. Scheduling and ordering stay manual.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the appointment and what to order stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not order against a blank amount.
tasks.altitude: The total is clerical. Scheduling and ordering stay at full effort, and the order is not sent by a rule.

reach.task: Receive only an order the photographer placed

evidence.claim: Stored appointments can be listed and stored amounts can be totalled. Ordering supplies stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with the day's office duties and ends when the photographer has placed an order or stopped.

The diary has date, time, and who, written by the photographer when the appointment is made. A book line has description and amount, entered by the photographer. A blank amount is left blank and is not treated as zero. Showing a diary that already exists is not counted as saved labour.
The total does not place the order and does not set the appointment. Nobody is scored.
unknowns: Which supplies the photographer orders, and which a colleague orders.
research_questions: How often did a blank amount stop the total?

already_counted.description: Ordering supplies is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: Correct an amount before the totals are accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: amounts are often blank, so the photographer still keeps the book and still schedules. High: amounts are complete, the totals are shown, and the photographer still schedules and still places the order. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review sets and select the best

steps.what: Flag photograph frames for sharpness or closed eyes

loop.purpose: Flag a frame that is not sharp or that shows closed eyes.
loop.input: The frame identifier. No person name is read.
loop.output: A flag on that frame, or a stop. No person name is written.
loop.check: Every flag cites a frame identifier that was supplied, and the flag text names no person.
loop.stop: Stop when the frame has no pixels to read, and do not guess a flag.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot see whether a frame is sharp or whether the eyes are closed. The flag is not the selection.

steps.what: Review sets of photographs to select the best

tasks.design: The photographer reviews sets of photographs to select the best work. A flag can mark sharpness or closed eyes. It does not name a person and it does not select the picture. The photographer still reviews the set and selects, at full effort. {DOCS} does not publish the selection.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer looked through the set and selected.
tasks.enabler_now: A flag can mark a frame. The selection stays the photographer's.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting the best work stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer rejects a flag that does not match the frame they see.
tasks.altitude: The flag is a first mark only. The review and the selection stay at full effort.

reach.task: See only the pictures the photographer selected

evidence.claim: Excire Foto can flag sharpness and facial expression and can add keywords. The photographer still reviews the set.
Naming a person from a face is biometric identification and is not done here.

assumptions: The work starts with a set and ends when the photographer has selected, or stops. Nothing is published.
A frame has a frame identifier and the image file, already on the card. The flag writes no person name. A frame with nothing to read is skipped, not guessed.
The flag replaces only the first scan for sharpness or closed eyes. It does not select. The photographer still chooses the best frame, at full effort.
unknowns: Which jobs expect a shortlist, and of what size.
research_questions: How often did the photographer overrule a flag?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the set and selecting is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: Remove a flag the photographer has overruled.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many frames have no pixels, so only part of the scan is flagged, and the photographer still selects. High: frames can be read, the scan is flagged, and the photographer still selects the best frame. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The photographer still shoots, retouches, and chooses the picture. A caption or a licence is written or sent only after the photographer accepts that version.
reach: A client receives only a caption the photographer has accepted.
An agency receives only a licence the photographer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required reading, field, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the shot, the retouch, and the selection in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every caption traces to stored who, what, where, and when, and the photographer still rewrites the sentence.
